info.title: ACL_Object_Group
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

cfg_addresses.description: List of IP addresses configured by the user: IPv4 format (A.B.C.D/W.X.Y.Z) IPv6 format (A:B::C:D/W:X::Y:Z) If an invalid format is used via REST, it will be accepted. Verify configurations are valid by checking for error log messages and configuration warnings in CLI. An empty column value indicates that no match criteria is specified for this list.

cfg_ports.description: List of ports that are currently programmed in the data path. The sequence number is used for indexing but does not affect packet handling behavior. An empty column value indicates that no match criteria is specified for this list.

l4_port_max.description: Maximum L4 port to match on the packet.

l4_port_min.description: Minimum L4 port to match on the packet.

cfg_version.description: The version of 'cfg_addresses' or 'cfg_ports' which should be changed to a random value each time 'cfg_addresses' or 'cfg_ports' are modified. An empty column value will indicate that the user does not want the system to process this configuration yet.

cur_addresses.description: List of IP addresses that are currently programmed in the data path: IPv4 format (A.B.C.D/W.X.Y.Z) IPv6 format (A:B::C:D/W:X::Y:Z) If an invalid format is used via REST, it will be accepted. Verify configurations are valid by checking for error log messages and configuration warnings in CLI.

cur_ports.description: List of ports that are currently programmed in the data path.

l4_port_max.description: Maximum L4 port to match on the packet.

l4_port_min.description: Minimum L4 port to match on the packet.

in_progress_addresses.description: List of IP addresses that are being processed for installation into the data path: IPv4 format (A.B.C.D/W.X.Y.Z) IPv6 format (A:B::C:D/W:X::Y:Z) If an invalid format is used via REST, it will be accepted. Verify configurations are valid by checking for error log messages and configuration warnings in CLI.

in_progress_ports.description: List of ports that are being processed for installation into the data path.

l4_port_max.description: Maximum L4 port to match on the packet.

l4_port_min.description: Minimum L4 port to match on the packet.

in_progress_version.description: The version of the in-progress Object Group.  This value is copied from 'cfg_version' when Object Group processing begins. This value is cleared when the Object Group status is updated to 'applied' or 'rejected.'

name.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL_Object_Group](#/ACL_Object_Group)
Name of the ACL Object Group.

object_type.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL_Object_Group](#/ACL_Object_Group)
Type of ACL Object Group indicating which kind of entries it contains. If the type is 'ipv4' or 'ipv6', the port attributes are ignored. If the type is 'l4port', the address attributes are ignored.

code.description: Numeric error code.  Expected to be 0 when state is 'applied'.

message.description: Detailed reason for error state.  Expected empty when state is 'applied'.

version.description: The version of 'cur_addresses' or 'cur_ports' that corresponds to this status.

vsx_sync.description: Controls which attributes should be synchronized between VSX peers.  'all_attributes_and_dependents': the entire address group should be synchronized. This column value should be empty when system should not synchronize attributes between VSX peers.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
